fixes.issue: Sender format and transport controls could disagree with a running output
fixes.reproduction: NDI format choices remained editable after startup, and changing Display/NDI only updated saved configuration and content events. The full update/reconcile path did not stop or restart the active transport.
fixes.fix: Lock source and format choices during native startup and active NDI. Lock Display/NDI selection during startup or any active output.
fixes.verification: Three component regressions cover active NDI, an open physical display, and deferred native startup with failure recovery. Typecheck, scoped ESLint and Prettier pass.

fixes.issue: Hidden WebKit DOM timer throttling limited optimized NDI output to about 1 fps despite its 24 fps setting
fixes.reproduction: Thirty optimized-release image frames took 28.923 seconds, or 1.003 fps. Ten motion-video frames contained seven unique hashes but arrived at only 1.025 fps. Native source timecodes also advanced about one second per frame.
fixes.fix: Cancellable native intervals emit output render ticks at configured cadence; the frontend receives these without a DOM timer and keeps its one-in-flight binary frame guard.
fixes.nativeRetest: Passed in the optimized app. Native clock restored static output to 24.32 fps. After the main decoded-video-frame workaround, moving output reached 24.16 fps with all 45 fixture frames represented.
fixes.tests: Four Rust clock lifecycle and pacing tests and four frontend scheduler tests pass. Typecheck, scoped lint, formatting and strict main-crate Clippy across all targets pass.
fixes.eventIsolation: Native ticks target only their corresponding webview window.

fixes.issue: Theme Designer stayed black when WebKit suspended requestAnimationFrame
fixes.reproduction: Actual optimized native Designer controls and saving worked, but its canvas stayed black. Initial fit and theme synchronization waited for application RAF, followed by another Fabric RAF.
fixes.fix: Coalesce dirty edits on RAF with a bounded 100 ms fallback and paint Fabric directly. Initial fit uses the same scheduler, selection-only updates avoid rebuilding the bitmap, and unmount cancels pending work before disposing Fabric.
fixes.verification: Five deterministic regressions, full typecheck, scoped ESLint and Prettier pass. Final optimized native UI now visibly paints Genesis 1:1 over the ocean background at 25% fit, and the saved custom Notes theme retains Center alignment after restart.

constraints: The disconnected GoStream Duet hardware was not tested. Its documented format and resolution constraints were simulated separately.
Installed NDI SDK receiver supports more formats than GoStream Duet; successful loopback decoding does not establish Duet compatibility.

Actual optimized native throughput passed at 1920x1080/24 fps for motion video and 1280x720/30 fps for static Notes. Backend 24/30/60 tests validate descriptors and transport; sustained native performance was not measured for every resolution and rate combination.
Parent tested the physical display separately. This subtask used only loopback receivers.
No user keyring reads, HX license purchases, or cloud API calls in this subtask.
